profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Cummins Power Generation
profile.summary:
Worked on a variety of jobs from simple troubleshooting to large projects utilizing PLCs such as PLC 5, Micrologix, SLC, CompactLogix, ControlLogix, Quantum, Modicon, DirectLogic and other equipment such as DeviceNet, Ethernet/IP, RS-485, RS-232, DataHighway, DSL, Fiber Optic, Stratix switches, Remote I/O, PanelView, PanelView Plus, FactoryTalk View ME, FactoryTalk View SE, Vijeo Citect, AB VFD, Siemens VFD, VM Ware, AutoCAD Electrical, etc.
Tested, troubleshot and setup equipment that utilized Micrologix PLCs, PanelViews, Electromechanical relays, transformers, capacitors, resistors, inductors, chokes, etc.
Worked in a variety of fields such as Coal(Underground Continuous Mining Longwall Mining, Preparation Plants, Overland Conveyor Systems, Crushing and Sorting Systems, Train Loading Stations), Aggregate, Water, Wastewater, Power Plant, Lumber Mills, Explosives Manufacturing
Preventative Maintenance, Repair, and Installation of a variety of equipment and sensors, including but not limited to Conveyors, MCCs, PLCs, Pneumatic Valves, Air Compressors, Pumps, Motors, Proximity, Temperature, Distance, Level, Ultrasonic, Flow, and Nuclear Density.
